prompt:
以下はある英語ニュースpodcast記事のFull Story・Point One・Point Twoです。
Point One・Point Twoそれぞれについて、以下6項目を判定してください
(それぞれPASS/FAIL)。

- qa_not_caveat_only: このPointが、研究上の限界・一般化上の注意・免責事項
  だけで構成されていない場合PASS(それらに加えて実質的な新しい内容がある
  場合もPASS。留保だけでPoint枠全体が終わっている場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_full_story_paraphrase: Full Storyの要約・言い換えに留まっていない
  場合PASS(Full Storyの中心的なlogic・結論を語彙だけ変えて繰り返している
  場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_other_point_paraphrase: もう一方のPointの要約・言い換えになって
  いない場合PASS
- qa_explains_why_it_matters: 「だから何なのか」を具体的に説明できている
  場合PASS(聞き手にとっての具体的な意味・示唆がある場合)
- qa_specific_not_generic: この記事のLedger固有の内容に基づいており、他の
  どんな記事にもほぼそのまま流用できる一般論になっていない場合PASS
- qa_adds_new_value: 新しい理解・解釈・意外性・具体的示唆のいずれかを
  実際に加えている場合PASS(Full Storyだけを聞いた場合と比べて、聞き手の
  理解が実際に深まっている場合)

reasoningには、判定理由を1〜2文の日本語で書いてください(特にFAILの場合は
具体的な理由を明記してください)。

【Full Story】
On August 16, at Mazda Stadium, the Hanshin Tigers turned an early lead into a clear win over the Hiroshima Carp.

The key moment came in the first inning. Teruaki Sato hit a two-run home run to center field, giving Hanshin the lead before Hiroshima scored.

Starting pitcher Rihito Ihara gave that lead a strong base. He worked five innings, allowed only two hits, and gave up one run. Hiroshima’s only run came in the fifth, when Elehuris Montero hit a solo home run.

That cut the gap for a moment, but it did not change the game. Hanshin added runs in the seventh and eighth innings. The early lead kept growing, and Hiroshima never found a way back.

The final score was:

Hiroshima 1–8 Hanshin

This was not a close escape. It was a complete Hanshin victory, built on an early hit, steady pitching, and more scoring later in the game.

【Point One】
Hanshin’s later scoring came from several players. In the seventh, Seishiro Sakamoto drove in a run, and pinch-hitter Tora Fushimi did the same. In the eighth, Sakamoto added a timely double. Those attacks kept extending the lead, so the win did not depend only on Sato’s opening home run.

【Point Two】
Montero’s home run gave Hiroshima one scoring play, but not a continuing attack. The Carp finished with only one run. They reduced the gap once, yet never produced enough pressure to seriously threaten Hanshin’s lead. The home team had a moment, but Hanshin controlled the larger story.
